scenes.text: Ember was born where the wind never stopped running, and his herd ran with it.
Then one night, a storm tore the canyon apart. When the thunder faded, the herd was gone.
He searched the empty plains for days, always looking back toward the mountains.
Men found him first. A rope took his freedom, and the corral took his name.
He pulled iron and stone for the railroad. Every step was heavy, and every night was silent.
But in his dreams, a gentle voice still called him home, and the meadow was still warm.
One storm, one snapped rope, and Ember ran. He never stopped. He never looked back.
On a quiet ridge at sunrise, he heard a neigh. The herd had never stopped waiting for him.
